blocks.text: Multi-platinum singer-songwriter Rex Orange County unveils his highly anticipated new album, ‘Dream Fatigue’, today. His most self-assured work to date, the record finds Rex arriving at a renewed sense of artistic conviction, fully embracing his identity while pushing into new creative territory, with an acclaimed circle of collaborators further expanding his sonic vision. Fans can stream the new album HERE. ‘Dream Fatigue’ is co-executive produced by Mustafa and Dylan Wiggins (Rosalía, Justin Bieber), and features contributions from Turnstile’s Brendan Yates, Dev Hynes, Daniel Caesar, Mustafa, dexter in the newsagent and Taylor Skye of Jockstrap.
